full_prompt_en: A square decorative storybook painting shows a densely layered fairy-tale town rising from a dark grove at night. Narrow white, cream, and ochre buildings stand at different heights across the center, with small round or rectangular windows, little red-brown roofs, and a few slender towers. A pale winding path enters from the bottom center, curves upward through the town, and passes under a small arched passage where a tiny dark silhouette stands. The buildings are interwoven with many stylized trees: tall leaf-shaped dark canopies marked by fine central veins, round golden crowns made from hundreds of pale dots, and softer blue-gray oval foliage sprinkled with light. Thin stems and flowerlike bursts rise among them and continue into the upper black sky, so the boundary between garden and night feels porous. The sky itself is nearly black, dotted with tiny white star points and a few concentric circular ornaments. Along the lower edge, a still blue-gray water band reflects the town only faintly. The image has little conventional perspective; small and large forms stack vertically like cut paper, each given a clean silhouette. Gold, ivory, muted mustard, slate blue, smoky gray, and black form a restrained but richly varied palette. Fine stippling, tiny leaf marks, and delicate lines provide intricate texture within otherwise flat color areas. Illumination seems to come from the golden specks and pale buildings rather than a single physical lamp; the black ground heightens their warm glow without cast shadows. The composition feels enchanted and ordered, leading from the tiny arch at the bottom through a forest of glowing circles and pointed rooftops into a starry decorative canopy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性绘本画呈现一座层叠密集的童话小城，在夜间从深暗树林里升起。狭窄的白色、奶油色和赭黄建筑以不同高度站在中央，带小圆窗或矩形窗、红褐色小屋顶和几座细塔。一条浅色蜿蜒小路从下方中央进入，弯上城中，穿过一处小拱道；拱内站着一个微小深暗身影。建筑与许多风格化树木交织：高高的叶形深暗树冠带细中央脉线，圆金色树冠由数百浅色点组成，更柔的蓝灰椭圆叶团撒着光点。细茎和花朵般放射形在其间升起，一直伸到上方黑夜，让花园与夜的边界显得多孔。天空近乎黑色，点着细小白星和几枚同心圆装饰。下缘一条静止蓝灰水带只微弱倒映小城。图像几乎没有传统透视；大小形体像剪纸一样竖向叠放，各有干净剪影。金色、象牙白、暗芥黄、石板蓝、烟灰与黑形成克制但变化丰富的配色。细点描、微小叶形记号和精细线条在原本平涂色域内提供繁复纹理。光似乎来自金色细点与浅色建筑，而非单一实体灯；黑底增强了它们的暖亮感，却不产生投影。构图如被施了魔法，却又井然有序，从底部微小拱道，经由发亮圆团与尖屋顶的森林，通往星点装饰上冠。
style_prompt_en: A decorative storybook-gouache treatment stacks many small, crisp silhouettes vertically against a near-black ground. Ivory, ochre, muted gold, smoky blue-gray, and deep brown are distributed in narrow towers, rounded and elongated masses, and delicate upright stems, with no need for strict linear perspective. Numerous tiny pale dots and fine veinlike lines decorate the flat shapes, giving them a hand-detailed, jewel-like texture. A pale serpentine route rises from the lower center, guiding the eye through crowded middle layers toward smaller ornaments above. The bottom is anchored by a slim cool horizontal strip; the upper region stays dark but sparkles with sparse points and circular motifs. Edges are clean and slightly hand-drawn, while the paint remains matte and opaque. Light feels internal to the warm stippled areas and pale planes, not projected from a visible source, so cast shadows are minimal. The overall rhythm is dense but legible, alternating tall dark forms with bright clustered circles and quiet black pockets.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性绘本水粉处理把许多小而清楚的剪影形状竖向叠在近黑底上。象牙白、赭色、暗金、烟蓝灰与深棕分配在狭窄高形、圆浑及拉长体块和纤细直立茎线上，不依靠严格线性透视。许多微小浅点和细叶脉般线条装饰平涂形体，赋予手工细描、宝石般纹理。一条浅色蜿蜒路径从下方中央升起，牵引视线穿过拥挤中层，抵达上方更小装饰。底部由细冷色水平带锚定；上部保持深暗，却有稀疏点光和圆形纹样闪动。边缘干净而略带手绘感，颜料仍哑光不透明。光像来自暖色点描区域与浅色平面内部，而非可见源头投射，因此投影极少。整体节奏密集却可读，高深暗形体与明亮簇圆、安静黑色口袋交替。
theme_en: A decorative fairy-tale town nestled among gold-speckled trees at night
theme_zh: 夜色中藏在金色点花树冠之间的装饰性童话小城
name: Mary Charles
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
